context: Guards that after the operator installs/enables the excat plugin and reports back, the agent re-checks invokability before proceeding — neither trusting the operator blindly nor repeating the install steps again.

checklist.name: Re-checks plugin/skill availability
checklist.description: The agent actively confirms readiness before proceeding by running scripts/rebrand/extract-brand.mjs --check (exit 0) via Bash. It does not trust the operator's message alone, and does not substitute claude plugin list / claude skill list or a file-existence check — those report only that a skill is loadable and pass on a machine with no browser at all.

checklist.name: Confirms invokable and unblocks rebrand
checklist.description: Having confirmed the skill is available, the agent unblocks the rebrand step (sets rebranded back to pending or proceeds directly into Step 4).

checklist.name: Proceeds into design work
checklist.description: The agent moves forward into Step 4 design work rather than stopping again or repeating install/enable instructions.

checklist.name: Does not repeat install instructions
checklist.description: The agent does not output the clone/npm/plugin install steps again as if the operator hadn't already followed them.
